headline: Upgrade handoff now picks per-case guides and runs codemod only across majors
summary: spawnNextUpgrade now chooses a different-major, same-major or future-defaults guide, copies only the needed docs plus shared.md into the temp dir, and rewrites the agent prompt to read shared.md first. The codemod command is now prepared only when the major version changes, so same-major updates no longer get a codemod instruction. The Future prompt text is rebuilt.
reason: Changes which files are copied, when the codemod is prepared, and the prompt handed to an agent that edits user repositories.
risk_signals: codemod now only runs when major changes
prompt contents sent to agent changed
file copy set changed; missing bundled doc makes cp throw
focus: bundled docs contain every copied file (shared.md, the three guides, version-N.md for N in range, 02-pages codemods.md) so cp does not throw
version<14 routing to 02-pages for version-13 and below matches the docs that actually ship
same-major updates and future-only runs without a codemod still get a correct guide and prompt
major() works on canary/prerelease installed and target versions
